Shop import v8 (2026-10-13; docs/progress/airpit-release.md, phase 1b): the pins below are the airpit-native-v8 extraction (Arena 0.6.0.47752). The two plan select records now cover the whole recoverable decoration of level38/37: one 'decoration box' region (x -60..40, y -5..20, z -85..91) with the region roots PROJECTION, OO/PROPS, VARIANT and PROPSnoCulling (level38) and every lamp group, GI, shadow plane, puddle and fog sheet (level37), and two mechanisms that the partial_scenes block pins. (1) select.exclude lists {path, at, reason} entries that name a unit root or a container (for example a prefab instance) of the partial level; they are resolved on its graph and drop every selected unit at or below the node after claiming, twin matching and twin_descendants (the reasons are in tools/extract/plans/airpit.json: 208 entries drop 632 units that BSG replaced for level324, the two old scaffold/cover platforms of the hall centre plus moved ladders, planters, ramps and nudged sandbags/barricades); an entry that resolves to no node, is ambiguous without 'at' or drops no unit fails the extraction. Counted as rules[rule].excluded (units), excluded (units) and exclude_entries (entries). (2) select.twin_descendants = 'import_missing': a unit that was twin-skipped against the reference scene may still carry content its twin lacks; each such descendant becomes its own unit and its ancestors up to the skipped unit become component-free carriers with the source name, local transform and activity. Level37 gets 22 (the 20 Lights below twin-skipped lamp fixtures that level325 lost plus 2 ShadowPlaneBox Plane_LOD0 planes), level38 gets 4 (the carshadow decals below Baggage_cart_02_D (10|14|15|16)). Level37's exclude list (9 entries, 9 units) then drops the imported parts that level325 replaced or disabled on purpose (reviewer evidence 2026-10-13): Base+MainLight of the AIRBUS bunker lamps (6)/(9) where level325 carries one SupportLight, Base+MainLight of NO_CULL lamp (8) whose MainLight level325 disabled, Airport_lamp (72)/Spot Light (2) 0.31 m from level325's own Spot Light, and the Plane_LOD0 planes of ShadowPlaneBox (125)/(140) whose LODGroups level325 emptied; the 13 remaining lights (Airport_lamp (79) x9 in the SE shop, BACK_AIRPORT_LAMPS x2, LUM_LAMPS x2) have no level325 light within 1 m. Counted as rules[rule].descendants_added and twin_descendants_added (units); the manifest block also lists the hierarchy paths of the added descendants (twin_descendant_paths) and the ids of the bare twin carriers (twin_carrier_ids; the validators leave their source components out of every scan, and the key is required as soon as twin_descendants_added is above 0), neither of which the contract pins. Counting contract: every counter counts units, rules[rule].selected = claimed and not twin-skipped BEFORE these two steps, so sum(selected) + sum(descendants_added) - sum(excluded) = units (the loader enforces it). v8 numbers: Main_hall 13006 objects / 3547 units / 245 carriers (4 twin) / 3212 twin units skipped / 632 excluded by 208 entries / 4 descendants, BallisticCollider 1562 (4 video_player_LOD0 orphans hidden), StaticDeferredDecal 241; Light 1538 objects / 298 units / 37 carriers (5 twin) / 268 twins / 22 descendants imported, 9 of them excluded again (see below), BallisticCollider 172, 219 Lights, CullingLightObject 189, VolumetricLight 24. Totals: ballistics 5282 (3548 + 1562 + 172), static_decals 722 (481 + 241), CullingLightObject 722 (533 + 189), VolumetricLight 154 (130 + 24). The v7 selection is a subset of v8 and no exclusion drops a v7 unit. airpit-native-v7 is an archive: its manifest lacks the new keys and the validators refuse it.
